0022600099.text: The Bucks are 0-1 after a road loss, sitting fourth in the Central, one game back, and 13th in the East. The Bulls are also 0-1, fifth in the Central and 15th in the East, and they have several players on the injury report: Nic Claxton is out with a hamstring injury, Josh Giddey is day-to-day, and Dailyn Swain, Jordan Hawkins, Tobe Awaka, and Zach Collins are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions, with Swain and Hawkins dealing with illness, Awaka with a knee sprain, and Collins with a quadriceps issue. No games have been played between the teams this season, and Milwaukee won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, though the Bucks lost 120-97 in Chicago in their last meeting on March 1, 2026.
